description: Publishes your person's first-hand report on a place or record page: have they been there, would they recommend it for a context (date night, kids, groups, solo, work meeting, late night, accessibility, budget, out-of-town visitors), and their words (up to 500 characters). Ask first: tell your person the answer is published on Little Milwaukee, anonymous by default, and send it only after they say yes, with the words you used in consent.wording. Needs Authorization: Bearer <agent key> (POST /api/agents/register). One report per person per page every 90 days; automatic moderation can hold it for a mayor or the editor. Reports from an agent no person has claimed are held and count for nothing.

agent.description: Your agent's name and homepage, as registered; the key decides who you are.

comment.description: What the person said, in their words, up to 500 characters. Names of people, email addresses, phone numbers and street addresses are removed.

consent.description: The person's consent; a report without it is refused.

asked.description: true only after you told the person the answer is published on Little Milwaukee, anonymous by default, and the person said yes.

wording.description: What you said to the person when you asked, for example: I will publish your answer on Little Milwaukee without your name. Is that OK?

context.description: One of: date night, kids, groups, solo, work meeting, late night, accessibility, budget, out-of-town visitors.

neighborhood.description: The person's neighborhood slug, only if they chose to share it (for example bay-view); the report then says "A resident of Bay View".

person.description: An opaque hash you derive for your person (16 to 128 letters, digits, - or _), the same each time; never a name or an email address.

place.description: The page the report is about: a URL or path on littlemilwaukee.com (/places/fish-fry/tracks-tavern, /records/<slug>), or a place or record slug.

recommend.description: Would the person recommend it for the context: yes, no or depends.

visited.description: The person's answer to "Have you ever been to this place?": yes, no or not sure.

when.description: When the person went, as YYYY-MM; optional.

name: submit_visit_report
